claim.claim-text: 1. An apparatus for producing nano-bubbles in a volume of liquid, the apparatus comprising:
2. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the at least one radially-extending member comprises one or more wings, vanes, propellers, or combinations thereof.
3. The apparatus of claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the at least one radially-extending member is fixedly coupled to the outer surface of the axially rotatable permeable member.
4. The apparatus of claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the at least one radially-extending member is integral with the outer surface of the axially rotatable permeable member.

5. The apparatus of any one of claims 1-4, wherein the at least one radially-extending member is configured to move the liquid away from an outer surface of the body of the axially rotatable permeable member to prevent nano-bubble coalescence.

6. The apparatus of any one of claims 1-5, further comprising a rotatable tube support including an elongate body having a wall and defining an inner cavity, the wall defining a plurality of perforations, the inner cavity of the rotatable tube support configured to house the axially rotatable permeable member, the rotatable tube support coupled to and rotatable along with the rotatable shaft of the motor.
7. The apparatus of claim 6, wherein the at least one radially-extending member is coupled to the rotatable tube support.

8. The apparatus of any one of claims 1-7, wherein the axially rotatable permeable member has an outer circumference defined by an outer diameter sized to simulate turbulent flow above the turbulent threshold of the liquid.
9. The apparatus of any one of claims 1-8, wherein the pores of the rotatable permeable member have a diameter in a range of from 200 nm to 50 µm.
10. The apparatus of any one of claims 1-9, the pores of the rotatable permeable member have a diameter that is less than or equal to 50 µm.
11. The apparatus of any one of claims 1-10, wherein the nano-bubbles have a mean diameter ranging from 10 nm to 500 nm.
12. The apparatus of any one of claims 1-11, wherein the nano-bubbles have a mean diameter ranging from 75 nm to 200 nm.
13. The apparatus of any one of claims 1-12, wherein the nano-bubbles have a mean diameter ranging from 50 nm to 150 nm.
14. A method for producing nano-bubbles in a volume of liquid using the apparatus of any one of claims 1-13, the method comprising:
15. The method of claim 14, wherein the pressure of the gas flowing into the axially rotatable permeable member is 101,325 kPa to 1013,25 kPa.
